rapport_notes: Friendly and unbothered when the customer had to jump to another call mid-quote; no friction, but call ended before real rapport could build.
top_strength: Moved efficiently through intake and had pricing ready almost immediately, respecting that the customer needed to take another call.
coaching_note: The call was cut off before any of the three differentiators (damage coverage, Meet Your Mover, On-Time Guarantee) were mentioned — worth leading with those on the callback before diving back into price.
